🍎: DSBN Trustee, Niagara Falls 
☀️: Certified Granola Girl

images.caption:
As a mother of a Grade 10 student, I’ve felt first hand the result of Ford’s cuts to public education. As a Trustee, I’ve seen the challenges our system is facing and its impacts on our students. 

$6.5 billion has been cut from public education since 2018. Class sizes have grown. 67,000 students are waiting for autism supports. 77% of educators say they have personally witnessed or experienced violence at school.

Happy Onam to all who celebrate! 

Earlier this week I joined the @united_keralites_of_niagara for a beautiful celebration of harvest, gratitude, family and community. It was wonderful spending time with so many DSBN students and their parents. 

Thank you for sharing your traditions and for the warm welcome.

Our education workers are the heart of our public education system. From caring for our kindergarten children, welcoming students on their first day, meeting the needs of special education students, to keeping our facilities clean - they are truly the best. 

I’m proud to stand alongside our education workers as they fight for safe schools, proper funding for special education, and good jobs.

This afternoon, I officially filed my paperwork to be your Trustee with the District School Board of Niagara! 

Together, we’ve worked to build a Board dedicated to student success and well-being. 

We’ve created a culture of student achievement - improving graduation rates and surpassing provincial standards for standardized testing.
